Name: AutoForager
Author: DebugDew
Description:
[center]
[b][size=6][color=#FFD54F]✨ AutoForager ✨[/color][/size][/b]
[size=4][i]The ultimate automation tool for your daily chores![/i][/size]
[/center]
[size=4]
Tired of running around the map every day? Let [color=#FFD54F][b]AutoForager[/b][/color] handle all your daily collection tasks automatically. Gather forage, truffles, tapper products, farm cave items, mushroom logs, trash can loot, and much more without lifting a finger.

With our new [b]custom assignment UI[/b], smart chest management, automatic map detection, and overflow protection, your resources stay organized and safe.

Made for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b].[/size]

[line]

[b][size=5][color=#6EC6FF]🌟 Core Features[/color][/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Forage Collection:[/b][/color] Collects wild plants, flowers, and spring onions every morning. ([color=#FFA726][i]Default: 06:10 AM[/i][/color])[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Main & Backup Chests:[/b][/color] Assign a [color=#66CCFF][b]Main[/b][/color] chest and an optional [color=#66CCFF][b]Backup[/b][/color] chest for each category. If the Main chest is full, items are automatically stored in the Backup chest.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Sub-Chest System:[/b][/color] Assign optional sub-chests for Fruit & Bush items, Mushrooms, and Beach items. If a sub-chest is not assigned, those items are stored in the [color=#66CCFF][b]Forage[/b][/color] chest instead.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Bush Harvesting:[/b][/color] Automatically harvests Salmonberries, Blackberries, Tea Leaves, and items from custom bushes.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Moss Collection:[/b][/color] Collects moss from trees.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Artifact & Seed Spots:[/b][/color] Digs up artifact spots and seed spots automatically.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Tree Shaking:[/b][/color] Shakes trees to collect fruits and seeds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Farm Cave Collection:[/b][/color] Collects mushrooms or fruits from your farm cave.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Mushroom Log Support:[/b][/color] Automatically collects mushrooms.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Crab Pot Management:[/b][/color] Automatically gathers loot from your Crab Pots and applies bait.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Trash Can Collection:[/b][/color] Checks town trash cans without losing friendship. Villagers will never see you.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Truffle Collection:[/b][/color] Collects truffles from your pigs every evening. ([color=#FFA726][i]Default: 05:00 PM[/i][/color])[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Tapper Collection:[/b][/color] Automatically collects products from all Tappers and Heavy Tappers.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Overflow Protection:[/b][/color] If all assigned chests are full, items remain in their original location and are not collected until storage becomes available. [color=#66BB6A][b]Nothing is lost.[/b][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]HUD Notifications:[/b][/color] Shows alerts when a chest is missing, broken, or when your storage is full.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Chest Labels:[/b][/color] Hold your hotkey ([i][color=#66BB6A]Default: Left Alt[/color][/i]) to display category labels above your chests.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b][size=5][color=#6EC6FF]📦 How It Works & Setup[/color][/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]New Assignment UI:[/b][/color] Stand next to a chest and press [b]J[/b] (default key) to open the brand new custom assignment menu. From here, you can easily set Main/Backup chests for any category, mass-assign chests, or reset links in a highly intuitive interface.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Automatic Map Detection:[/b][/color] The mod comes pre-loaded with default locations. For new areas, simply enter the area once and the mod will remember them automatically.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Customization:[/b][/color] Enable or disable any map or category, change collection times, configure notifications, and manage your settings using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b][size=5][color=#6EC6FF]🔌 Compatibility[/color][/size][/b]

[size=4]Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].

[color=#66BB6A][b]✔ Fully compatible with:[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][size=4]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][size=4]Ridgeside Village[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][size=4]East Scarp[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][size=4]Cornucopia[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][size=4]DeepWoods[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][size=4]Legacy Greenhouse[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Alchemistry[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Walk Of Life[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4]And many other custom maps thanks to automatic map detection.[/size]
